name: bro
description: Claude Code, at home in bro: your bro theme on every pixel, plus your sessions, limits and bro's tools one keystroke away.

flair.title: Theme flair
flair.description: The spinner and the turn line speak in your bro theme's voice: Forging… on Ember, Decrypting… on Matrix.

hud.title: Limits in the hint line
hud.description: Your login, its 5-hour and weekly use and the context fill, at the end of the hint line.

radar.title: Session radar
radar.description: A status line when another bro session is waiting on you or has finished.

tools.title: bro tools for Claude
tools.description: Claude can put a file in front of you in bro's preview, ping your phone, and check your other sessions.
